title: Pet Buddy
brief: Feed and play with a virtual pet while its hunger bar creeps up; win by raising its happiness to 8, lose if it gets too hungry.

title: Pumpkin Patch
brief: Plant pumpkins in three plots, wait for them to ripen orange and tap them to harvest 6 while tapping a crow away; three crow raids lose.

title: Diner Rush
brief: Cook a dish in the oven on a timer, then serve it to a waiting customer; serve 5 to win, lose lives when customers wait too long.

title: Aquarium Keeper
brief: Drop food flakes for a swimming fish and clean the dirty water with a button; make the fish happy 6 times to win, lose if the water runs out.

title: Herb Garden
brief: Keep the water bar up by watering three flowers while the sun slowly dries them; reach full bloom to win, lose if the water hits zero.

title: Chicken Coop
brief: Hens lay eggs on their own timers; tap eggs to fill the basket with 8 while tapping a chasing fox away, three fox hits lose.

title: Honey Bees
brief: Two bees carry nectar from flowers to the hive; tap the storm cloud to keep it from scattering them and deliver 8 honey to win.

title: Lemonade Stand
brief: Balance sugar and lemon with two buttons so the lemonade is not too sour or sweet for passing customers; earn 6 sales, three unhappy customers lose.

title: Pet Hotel
brief: Two rooms: feed a dog three times, then feed and pet a cat while a mouse bounces about; lose lives if a guest waits too long.

title: Milk Barn
brief: Wait until the cow glows gold, then tap the bucket to milk it; tapping too early annoys her, 8 buckets win, three bad taps lose.
